label: Zib
note: Zib has 11 different printed parts (13 pieces, two of each antenna part). The entries marked viewOnly (qty 0, no print file) exist only for the 3D viewer. The two right-hand antenna entries show both antennas (print the antenna stalk and the antenna ball twice each). The three paint entries show the painted details in color: paint them onto the printed head and eyes with acrylic paint pens. Everything is glued: the chest board goes in from the back and is closed by zib_back_cover.

parts.label: Body, legs and boots
parts.material: PLA, purple jumpsuit (dark purple boots, green legs)
parts.supports: Tree supports under the rounded back edge of the torso behind the legs, and inside the chest pocket (it opens at the back, so they come out through the hatch). The 20 mm roof of the hatch bridges: print it slowly with full cooling.
parts.notes: Pause at 7 mm to switch to green (#b4ea4c) for the legs and again at 14 mm to finish the torso in purple (#8a7cf4); the boots are #4a3f8f. Or paint. Press two M3 heat-set inserts into the 4.0 x 6.5 mm holes in the soles (x = +-12). The 7 mm cable channel runs from the sole up into the chest pocket; two 5 mm LED channels (2 mm apart, they overlap into one 7 x 5 mm slot) run from the pocket's roof up through the 10 x 6 mm neck peg. The chest pocket is 22 x 22 x 15 mm, centred behind the buckle (z = 28), and the chest board goes in from the BACK through the 20 x 20 mm hatch (trim the board to 19.6 x 19.6 mm or less; switch facing forward). The belt sits in the groove around the front and sides, the arms are glued to the flat sides with a 3 mm dowel in each 3.4 x 5 mm hole. About 40 x 34 x 51.5 mm.

parts.label: Head
parts.orientation: Flat seat down, face toward the front of the bed
parts.supports: Tree supports under the lower half of the ellipsoid (it overhangs all around). None inside. Print at 10 to 15 % infill: it is an 89 cm3 solid.
parts.notes: A 70 x 50 x 51 mm ellipsoid (top at 96.5 mm). Thread the wires of LED 1 and LED 2 through the two straight 5 mm channels that split from the neck socket (10.4 x 6.5 mm, over the peg) to the two antenna sockets (x = +-14, leaning 20 degrees outward) before gluing. The eye sockets are ovals 18 x 22 mm, tilted 10 degrees, 2.5 mm deep at the shallowest edge (about 6 mm in the middle). The smile groove and the two cheek recesses are 0.6 mm deep: paint the cheeks pink (#ff80b6) and the smile dark (#14121e); a darker lower rim (#86c12f) is optional.

parts.label: Left eye (black insert)
parts.orientation: Flat back down, domed face up
parts.notes: Print at 0.12 mm layers. Glue it into the left socket (0.2 mm clearance a side); the domed face stands 0.4 mm proud of the skin. Paint the two raised dots white (#ffffff): the big one up and to the right, the small one down and to the left. The two eyes are mirror images, so the tilt matches the socket.

parts.label: Right eye (black insert)
parts.orientation: Flat back down, domed face up
parts.notes: Print at 0.12 mm layers. Glue it into the right socket (0.2 mm clearance a side). Paint the two raised dots white (#ffffff), the same way as on the left eye.

parts.label: Left arm
parts.orientation: Lying on its flat glue face
parts.supports: None needed; a brim helps (the flat face is only about 6 mm wide).
parts.notes: A 9 mm capsule ending in an 11 mm round hand. Glue the flat face to the torso's left side (0.2 mm gap) with a 3 mm dowel or a piece of filament, 9 mm long, in the blind 3.4 mm holes.

parts.label: Right arm
parts.orientation: Lying on its flat glue face
parts.supports: None needed; a brim helps (the flat face is only about 6 mm wide).
parts.notes: The mirror of the left arm. Glue it to the torso's right side with a 3 mm dowel, 9 mm long.

parts.label: Belt and buckle plate (bezel)
parts.orientation: Upright, buckle plate to the front (as it sits on the torso)
parts.supports: Small tree supports (about 5 mm tall) under the two side wings of the band. The 12.6 mm window bridges.
parts.notes: A 3 mm band around the front and sides of the torso (z 25.5 to 30.5) with the 17.6 x 15.6 mm buckle plate. Press the cap in from behind first, then glue the belt into its groove on the torso (0.1 mm clearance), before the chest board goes in. Window 12.6 x 10.6 mm, lip 1.6 mm.

parts.label: Buckle cap (the talk button)
parts.notes: The 12 x 10 mm button, 0.3 mm clear in the belt's window, with a 14 x 12 mm flange behind the lip so it cannot fall out and a 5 mm stem, 4 mm long, that stops 0.3 mm short of a 9.5 mm tall 6 x 6 mm switch on a 1.6 mm board resting against the back cover. LED 0 sits beside the switch behind the flange and lights the cap.

parts.label: Back cover (hatch plug)
parts.orientation: Flat inner face on the bed, back face up
parts.notes: Press fit in the 20 x 20 mm hatch in the torso's back (19.7 x 19.7 mm, 0.15 mm clearance a side) plus a drop of glue, after the chest board is in. Its inner face is the pocket's back wall: the board rests against it, so a press on the cap cannot push the board away. Its outer face follows the torso, so it ends flush.

parts.label: Antenna stalk (print 2)
parts.orientation: Standing on the big plug, rod up
parts.supports: None. Use a brim: the rod is only 4 mm thick.
parts.notes: Print two; they are the same part. Thread the three 30 AWG wires of the LED through the 2.4 mm bore. The small plug glues into the head's antenna socket; the green holder and the large plug carry the ball and put the LED board on the plug's end face. This id is the LEFT antenna (at -X, LED 1) in the 3D viewer.

parts.label: Antenna ball (print 2)
parts.supports: None. The 11 mm dome inside bridges.
parts.notes: Print two. Hollow (inner 11 mm) for the 10 mm LED board. Glue it over the board onto the stalk's plug through the 10.6 mm mouth. This id is the LEFT ball (LED 1) in the 3D viewer.

parts.label: Antenna stalk, right (viewer copy)
parts.orientation: Same part as the left stalk
parts.notes: View only: the right-hand antenna in its place for the 3D viewer. It is the same part as zib_antenna_stalk, so there is no print file of its own: print zib_antenna_stalk twice (it already has qty 2).

parts.label: Antenna ball, right (viewer copy)
parts.orientation: Same part as the left ball
parts.notes: View only: the right-hand ball (LED 2) in its place for the 3D viewer. Same part as zib_antenna_ball (qty 2 there); no print file of its own.

parts.label: Paint: eye highlights (white)
parts.notes: View only: a thin skin over the raised highlight dots on both eyes, so the 3D viewer can show them in their paint color. Not printed. Paint the two raised dots on each eye white (#ffffff) with an acrylic paint pen: the big dot up and to the right, the small one down and to the left.

parts.label: Paint: cheeks (pink)
parts.notes: View only: a thin plate over the two cheek recesses, so the 3D viewer can show them in their paint color. Not printed. Fill the two shallow cheek recesses on zib_head with pink (#ff80b6) using an acrylic paint pen.

parts.label: Paint: smile (dark)
parts.notes: View only: a thin plate over the smile groove, so the 3D viewer can show it in its paint color. Not printed. Fill the smile groove on zib_head with dark paint (#14121e) using an acrylic paint pen.
